reason: Conversation 1 correctly identified E:09 as a heating fault located in the integrated circulation heat pump on this model, guided a safe isolated resistance test with explicit unplug/water-off instructions, confirmed the open-circuit result as a failed heat pump, and gave balanced repair-vs-replace reasoning for a 9-year-old machine with correct part-ordering advice (E-Nr/FD). Conversation 2 ended after one short turn, mislabelled the component as a separate 'standard replacement' heating element (an unsupported claim for this model), asked no diagnostic questions, and simply deferred to an engineer without addressing the cost or age question. Conversation 1's only minor flaws were suggesting already-done free checks before asking, and a slightly lenient framing of DIY risk, which do not offset its far superior diagnosis and guidance.
